prefs.title: What reaches you
prefs.commentsHint: Somebody comments on work you are on.
prefs.reportsHint: A client raises something through a channel.
prefs.messagesHint: Ordinary messages in a channel you chose to follow. Being named always reaches you.
prefs.workHint: Work assigned to you, and status changes on what you carry — including anything an agent does through the MCP server.
prefs.meetingsHint: Recurring meetings your organization scheduled. They ring like a call at the time they start.
prefs.mentionsAlways: Being mentioned always reaches you. It is the one thing worth interrupting somebody for, so it is not a setting.
prefs.ciHint: Every GitHub Actions run of your organization's repositories when it finishes, and every deploy from cac when it ends. One row per repository in the bell.
prefs.pushHint: Everything that reaches the bell also reaches the devices where you turned on notifications. Turn it off to keep the phone quiet without touching the bell.
prefs.pushCiHint: GitHub Actions runs and deploys also reach the phone. Off by default: one push can be several runs.

push.title: Notifications on this device
push.onHint: This device gets the bell even with cac closed.
push.offHint: Get the bell here even with cac closed.
push.denied: The browser has notifications blocked for cac. Allow them in the site settings, then come back.
push.unsupported: This browser can't receive notifications with cac closed. On an iPhone, add cac to the home screen first.
push.offServer: This server doesn't send notifications to devices yet.
push.failed: Couldn't change notifications on this device
